fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) fell 32% in November, and the decline in AI chip demand following Nvidia CEO's resignation could impact NAND flash memory sales.
fields.summary_ko.1: According to SemiAnalysis, AI chip capital expenditure could decline by 19% in 2027, 28% in 2028, and 41% in 2029, though AI chip annual sales growth is still expected to reach 24% over the next five years.
